blocks.zh: 設備與軟體確效、初級驗證、方法適用性與比對測試
blocks.en: Equipment and Software Qualification and Validation, Primary Validation, Method Suitability and Comparability Testing

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 AMM/RMM（Alternative or Rapid Microbiological Method，替代/快速微生物方法）系統在正式方法驗證前，必須先完成 Equipment Qualification（設備確效，IQ/OQ/PQ）與 Computer System Validation（CSV，電腦系統驗證）的整體框架與文件要求
blocks.en: Understand the overall framework and documentation requirements for Equipment Qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) and Computer System Validation (CSV) that an AMM/RMM (Alternative or Rapid Microbiological Method) system must complete before formal method validation

blocks.zh: 釐清 Primary Validation（初級驗證）、Method Suitability（方法適用性）、Comparability Testing（比對測試）三個驗證階段各自的責任歸屬（供應商 vs 終端使用者）、執行時機與驗證標準的差異
blocks.en: Clarify the differences between the three validation stages, Primary Validation, Method Suitability and Comparability Testing, in terms of responsibility (supplier vs. end user), timing and validation criteria

blocks.zh: 掌握定性（qualitative）與定量（quantitative）AMM/RMM 各自需要評估的驗證指標（specificity、LoD、LoQ、accuracy、repeatability、ruggedness、robustness 等）
blocks.en: Master the validation parameters to be evaluated for qualitative and quantitative AMM/RMM respectively (specificity, LoD, LoQ, accuracy, repeatability, ruggedness, robustness and so on)

blocks.zh: 建立對「何時需要終端使用者自行重做初級驗證」「何時可援引供應商數據」的風險判斷邏輯，並理解統計比對方法（TOST、非劣性檢定）在準確度評估中的角色
blocks.en: Build the risk-based logic for deciding "when the end user must repeat the primary validation" and "when supplier data may be referenced", and understand the role of statistical comparison methods (TOST, non-inferiority testing) in assessing accuracy

blocks.zh: 5.2 Equipment and Software Qualification and Validation 設備與軟體確效與驗證
blocks.en: 5.2 Equipment and Software Qualification and Validation

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Equipment Qualification（設備確效）vs Method Validation（方法驗證）：這是兩個層級不同但緊密相扣的活動。設備確效證明的是「這台儀器/軟體本身」符合規格、能可靠運作；方法驗證證明的是「用這台已確效的儀器所執行的微生物方法」能達到預期的偵測、計數或鑑別目的。TR 33 的邏輯是：先確效硬體與軟體平台（5.2 節），再驗證架構在其上的分析方法（5.3-5.4 節）——順序不能顛倒，否則驗證結論會建立在一個未經證實可靠的平台上。
blocks.en: Equipment Qualification vs. Method Validation: These are two activities at different levels that are closely linked. Equipment qualification demonstrates that "this instrument/software itself" meets specifications and operates reliably; method validation demonstrates that "the microbiological method run on this qualified instrument" can achieve its intended detection, enumeration or identification purpose. The logic of TR 33 is to qualify the hardware and software platform first (Section 5.2) and then validate the analytical method built on it (Sections 5.3-5.4). The order cannot be reversed, otherwise the validation conclusions would rest on a platform not yet shown to be reliable.

blocks.zh: 為何不必逐項循序驗證：原文明確指出 IQ 與 OQ 可以並行（parallel path），但 PQ 必須等 OQ 驗收合格且經審核核准後才能啟動。這反映了確效邏輯的因果順序——設備先「裝對」，才能證明「操作範圍內正確運作」，最後才能證明「長期持續產出正確結果」。
blocks.en: Why not everything must be validated one step at a time: The source states explicitly that IQ and OQ can be run in parallel, but PQ can start only after the OQ acceptance criteria have been met and the results reviewed and approved. This reflects the causal order of qualification logic: the equipment must first be "installed correctly", which allows you to show that it "operates correctly within its operating range", and only then can you show that it "consistently produces correct results over the long term".

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把整套 AMM/RMM 系統想像成一輛要投入營運的計程車：設備確效（IQ/OQ/PQ）就像「驗車」——先確認車子照規格正確組裝交車（IQ），再上路試驗煞車、轉向、儀表板功能是否在安全範圍內運作（OQ），最後長期載客觀察油耗與故障率是否穩定達標（PQ）。而方法驗證則是這輛車「能不能勝任載客生意」——即使車子本身驗車合格，也還要證明司機的駕駛技術、路線規劃（也就是微生物偵測方法本身）能安全準確地把乘客（微生物訊號）送到目的地。車子驗車不合格，討論駕駛技術毫無意義；同理，設備未確效，方法驗證的結論也站不住腳。
blocks.en: Think of the whole AMM/RMM system as a taxi about to enter service: equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) is like "vehicle inspection". First confirm the car was assembled and delivered to specification (IQ), then test on the road whether the brakes, steering and dashboard function within safe limits (OQ), and finally observe over a long period of carrying passengers that fuel consumption and failure rate stay stably on target (PQ). Method validation is whether the vehicle "can do the job of carrying passengers": even if the car passes inspection, you still have to show that the driver's skill and route planning (that is, the microbial detection method itself) can deliver passengers (microbial signals) to their destination safely and accurately. If the car fails inspection, discussing driving skill is pointless; likewise, if the equipment is not qualified, the conclusions of the method validation do not stand.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 原文特別提醒：「不需要驗證每一項功能」——只要那項功能在日常操作中不會被使用（例如熱感應印表機 vs 一般印表機二選一時，未採用的那項可不必測試），就可以在驗證計畫中明確排除並說明理由，或改為取得供應商的「符合性證明」（certificate of conformance）。這是Quality Risk Management (QRM) 原則在確效範疇界定上的實際應用——把驗證資源集中在真正會被使用、會影響病人安全與產品品質的功能上，而非機械式地測試每一個按鈕。對 CDMO 而言，這也直接影響驗證方案（Validation Protocol）的篇幅與執行時程，範疇界定不清楚往往是稽核時最常被挑戰的缺失之一。
blocks.en: The source specifically points out that "not every function needs to be validated": as long as a function will not be used in routine operation (for example, when a thermal printer and an ordinary printer are alternatives and one is not used), it can be explicitly excluded in the validation plan with a rationale, or replaced by obtaining the supplier's certificate of conformance. This is a practical application of Quality Risk Management (QRM) principles to defining the qualification scope: concentrate validation resources on the functions that will actually be used and that affect patient safety and product quality, rather than mechanically testing every button. For a CDMO this also directly affects the length and execution timeline of the validation protocol, and unclear scope definition is often one of the most frequently challenged deficiencies in audits.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若某 AMM/RMM 儀器同時支援藍牙資料傳輸與 USB 隨身碟匯出兩種資料輸出方式，但貴公司僅計畫使用 USB 匯出，應如何在驗證計畫中處理藍牙功能的測試範疇？
blocks.en: If an AMM/RMM instrument supports both Bluetooth data transfer and USB flash drive export, but your company plans to use only USB export, how should the testing scope for the Bluetooth function be handled in the validation plan?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 PQ 必須等到 OQ 驗收標準通過且經審核核准後才能啟動，而不能與 OQ 同時並行執行？
blocks.en: Why must PQ wait until the OQ acceptance criteria have been met and the results reviewed and approved, rather than running in parallel with OQ?

blocks.zh: 5.2.1 Documentation of the Validation Protocol 驗證方案之文件化
blocks.en: 5.2.1 Documentation of the Validation Protocol

blocks.zh: Validation Protocol（驗證方案）：是一份預先核准的文件，載明驗證的目的、範疇、測試方法、驗收標準與責任分工。原文雖然只有短短一段，但背後的規範重點是「執行結果必須被完整記錄下來，且能追溯回驗收標準」——這是 Good Documentation Practice (GDocP) 良好文件管理規範在確效領域的具體展現。
blocks.en: Validation Protocol: A pre-approved document that states the purpose, scope, test methods, acceptance criteria and division of responsibilities of the validation. Although the source devotes only a short paragraph to it, the underlying regulatory point is that "execution results must be fully recorded and traceable back to the acceptance criteria". This is a concrete expression of Good Documentation Practice (GDocP) in the qualification field.

blocks.zh: 就像考駕照時監考官手上的評分表——每一個測試項目（倒車入庫、路邊停車）都有預先訂好的通過標準，監考官必須逐項打勾記錄，而不是憑印象口頭說「你及格了」。IQ/OQ/PQ 各階段的 worksheet/checklist 就是這張評分表，確保每個驗收標準都有白紙黑字的證據支持。
blocks.en: It is like the scoring sheet in the examiner's hand during a driving test: every test item (reversing into a bay, parallel parking) has a pass standard set in advance, and the examiner must tick and record each one rather than say verbally from impression that "you passed". The worksheets/checklists for each IQ/OQ/PQ stage are this scoring sheet, ensuring that every acceptance criterion is supported by documented evidence.

blocks.zh: 稽核員審查確效資料時，最常見的缺失並非「測試沒做」，而是「做了但沒留下可追溯的紀錄」——例如缺少簽名日期、缺少原始數據附件、或驗收標準與方案不一致。將 worksheet/checklist 直接嵌入 IQ/OQ/PQ 各階段的方案中，可以強迫執行人員在測試當下就完成紀錄，降低事後回補（back-filling，屬於資料完整性風險）的機率。
blocks.en: When auditors review qualification data, the most common deficiency is not "the test was not done" but "it was done but no traceable record was left", for example missing signatures and dates, missing original data attachments, or acceptance criteria that do not match the protocol. Embedding the worksheets/checklists directly in the protocols for each IQ/OQ/PQ stage forces the executing personnel to complete the record at the time of the test and lowers the chance of back-filling afterwards (a data integrity risk).

blocks.zh: 若某 OQ 測試在執行當下未使用 checklist、而是測試完成數週後才憑記憶補寫報告，這會產生哪些資料完整性（data integrity）風險？
blocks.en: If an OQ test was executed without a checklist and the report was written from memory several weeks after the test was completed, what data integrity risks does this create?

blocks.zh: 5.2.2 Documentation of the Working Procedure 操作程序之文件化
blocks.en: 5.2.2 Documentation of the Working Procedure

blocks.zh: Working Procedure（操作程序）：指的是 Standard Operating Procedure (SOP，標準作業程序) 層級的書面指引，說明如何正確操作設備、執行方法工作流程。與 5.2.1 的 Validation Protocol 不同，這裡談的不是「如何驗證」，而是「日常怎麼操作」——兩者必須一致，否則驗證時所用的操作方式與日後例行操作方式不同，驗證結論就無法外推到常規使用。
blocks.en: Working Procedure: Written guidance at the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) level that explains how to operate the equipment correctly and carry out the method workflow. Unlike the Validation Protocol in 5.2.1, which is about "how to validate", this is about "how to operate day to day". The two must be consistent; otherwise the way of operating used during validation differs from the later routine operation, and the validation conclusions cannot be extrapolated to routine use.

blocks.zh: 人員資格確效（Personnel Qualification）：原文特別強調操作人員本身也需要「適當資格化」，且訓練必須在驗證活動開始前完成——這意味著人員訓練紀錄本身就是驗證套件（validation package）不可或缺的一部分證據。
blocks.en: Personnel Qualification: The source particularly stresses that the operators themselves must also be "appropriately qualified" and that training must be completed before validation activities begin. This means personnel training records are themselves an indispensable part of the evidence in the validation package.

blocks.zh: 如同醫院引進一台新的洗腎機：光是機器通過安裝與功能測試還不夠，醫院還必須有書面的操作手冊（SOP）教護理人員如何正確使用，並且要求每一位操作護理師先完成原廠或院內認證訓練並簽署紀錄，才能上線操作病人。沒有受訓紀錄的護理師即使技術再好，稽核時仍會被視為「未經確效授權的操作人員」。
blocks.en: It is like a hospital bringing in a new dialysis machine: it is not enough for the machine to pass installation and functional tests. The hospital must also have a written operating manual (SOP) teaching nurses how to use it correctly, and require every operating nurse to complete manufacturer or in-house certification training and sign the record before working on patients. A nurse without training records, however skilled, will still be regarded in an audit as an "operator not authorized through qualification".

blocks.zh: 訓練必須「先於」驗證活動開始，而非驗證結束後才補訓——因為如果操作人員在 PQ 階段才第一次接觸儀器，任何操作失誤產生的數據偏差，將無法判斷究竟是儀器/方法本身的問題，還是人員操作不熟練造成的干擾，進而污染整個驗證結論。
blocks.en: Training must be completed "before" validation activities begin, not made up after validation ends. If operators handle the instrument for the first time during PQ, any data deviation caused by an operating error cannot be attributed to either the instrument/method itself or the operators' lack of proficiency, which contaminates the whole validation conclusion.

blocks.zh: 若驗證方案中使用的操作步驟，與日後 QC 實驗室日常執行的 SOP 步驟不完全一致，會產生什麼問題？
blocks.en: What problems arise if the operating steps used in the validation protocol are not exactly the same as the SOP steps the QC laboratory later follows in routine work?

blocks.zh: 為什麼供應商原廠訓練紀錄也需要被納入驗證套件的文件範圍？
blocks.en: Why do the supplier's original training records also need to be included in the documentation scope of the validation package?

blocks.zh: 5.2.3 Computer System Validation and System Integration 電腦系統驗證與系統整合
blocks.en: 5.2.3 Computer System Validation and System Integration

blocks.zh: Computer System Validation (CSV，電腦系統驗證)：凡儀器內含電腦化系統，就必須進行 CSV，證明軟體規格符合使用者需求與預期用途，且透過軟體實作的特定需求能被「持續一致地達成」。這與單純的軟體測試不同——CSV 強調的是「一致性」與「可重現性」，而非只是一次性通過測試。
blocks.en: Computer System Validation (CSV): Wherever an instrument contains a computerized system, CSV must be performed to demonstrate that the software specifications meet user requirements and intended use, and that the specific requirements implemented through software are "consistently fulfilled". This differs from simple software testing: CSV emphasizes "consistency" and "reproducibility" rather than merely passing a test once.

blocks.zh: System Integration（系統整合）：當 AMM/RMM 儀器需要與 Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) 等資料管理平台對接時，除了儀器本身的 CSV，還需驗證「介面」本身——資料從儀器傳輸到 LIMS 的過程是否正確、完整、未遭竄改。原文特別指出責任可能分工：儀器供應商只需提供預先定義格式的輸出，介面邏輯的開發與驗證則由 LIMS 供應商獨立完成——這種責任劃分必須在 URS 與驗證計畫中清楚界定，避免出現「介面到底誰負責驗證」的責任真空地帶。
blocks.en: System Integration: When an AMM/RMM instrument needs to connect to a data management platform such as a Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), in addition to the CSV of the instrument itself, the "interface" itself must be validated: whether data are transferred from the instrument to the LIMS correctly, completely and without tampering. The source specifically notes that responsibilities may be divided: the instrument supplier only needs to provide output in a predefined format, while the development and validation of the interface logic are completed independently by the LIMS supplier. This division of responsibility must be clearly defined in the URS and the validation plan to avoid a responsibility vacuum over "who is actually responsible for validating the interface".

blocks.zh: 想像銀行的 ATM 提款機系統：ATM 主機本身的軟體（計算金額、判讀晶片卡）需要驗證（相當於 CSV），但 ATM 還要把交易紀錄即時傳送到銀行後端的核心帳務系統——這段「傳輸介面」也必須單獨驗證，確保金額不會在傳輸過程中被錯誤加總或遺失。如果 ATM 由甲廠商製造、核心帳務系統由乙廠商開發，兩者之間「誰負責驗證這段介面」就必須事先明確約定，否則出現金額對不上的問題時，兩家廠商可能互踢皮球。
blocks.en: Think of a bank ATM system: the ATM host software itself (calculating amounts, reading chip cards) must be validated (equivalent to CSV), but the ATM also transmits transaction records in real time to the bank's core accounting system, and this "transmission interface" must also be validated separately to ensure amounts are not wrongly totalled or lost in transit. If the ATM is made by vendor A and the core accounting system developed by vendor B, "who validates the interface between them" must be agreed in advance, otherwise when the amounts do not reconcile the two vendors may pass the blame back and forth.

blocks.zh: CSV 與系統整合驗證常見的稽核缺失，是企業只驗證了儀器本身的軟體，卻忽略了「儀器 → LIMS」這段資料傳輸介面的驗證——一旦數據在傳輸過程中發生截斷、格式錯位或延遲，即使儀器端數據正確，最終記錄在 LIMS 裡的結果仍可能是錯的，而這正是 21 CFR Part 11 電子紀錄可靠性所關注的核心風險之一。此議題與 Section 5.2.5（OQ 階段的資料完整性、稽核軌跡測試）緊密相關。
blocks.en: A common audit deficiency in CSV and system integration validation is that a company validates only the instrument's own software and overlooks validating the "instrument → LIMS" data transfer interface. If data are truncated, misaligned in format or delayed in transit, the result finally recorded in the LIMS may be wrong even though the data at the instrument end are correct, and this is exactly one of the core risks that the reliability of electronic records under 21 CFR Part 11 is concerned with. This topic is closely related to Section 5.2.5 (data integrity and audit trail testing at the OQ stage).

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 某 CDMO 引進一台快速微生物偵測儀，並要求其結果自動上傳至公司 LIMS 供 QC 放行使用。若儀器供應商僅承諾驗證儀器本身的軟體，而未對「儀器輸出格式與 LIMS 讀取邏輯」的介面進行驗證，該 CDMO 的 QA 應在 URS 階段就明確要求：（1）介面驗證責任歸屬（供應商或 LIMS 廠商或雙方共同執行）、（2）介面測試腳本涵蓋資料傳輸完整性與異常情境（如斷線重傳）、（3）最終由終端使用者審查並核准介面驗證報告，才能將該儀器數據用於批放行決策。
blocks.en: A CDMO introduces a rapid microbial detection instrument and requires its results to be uploaded automatically to the company LIMS for QC release use. If the instrument supplier promises to validate only the instrument's own software and not the interface between "the instrument output format and the LIMS reading logic", the CDMO's QA should state explicitly at the URS stage: (1) who is responsible for interface validation (the supplier, the LIMS vendor, or both jointly), (2) that the interface test scripts cover data transmission integrity and abnormal scenarios (such as retransmission after a disconnection), and (3) that the end user finally reviews and approves the interface validation report, before the instrument data may be used for batch release decisions.

blocks.zh: 若某 AMM/RMM 儀器僅獨立使用、不連接任何 LIMS 或外部資料庫，是否仍需要進行系統整合驗證？為什麼？
blocks.en: If an AMM/RMM instrument is used standalone and is not connected to any LIMS or external database, is system integration validation still needed? Why?

blocks.zh: 當儀器供應商與 LIMS 供應商對介面驗證責任認知不一致時，終端使用者應如何在 URS/驗證計畫中預先釐清？
blocks.en: When the instrument supplier and the LIMS supplier understand their responsibility for interface validation differently, how should the end user clarify this in advance in the URS/validation plan?

blocks.zh: 5.2.4 Equipment Installation Qualification 設備安裝確效
blocks.en: 5.2.4 Equipment Installation Qualification

blocks.zh: Installation Qualification (IQ，安裝確效)：證明設備已「正確且安全地」安裝，公用設施（utilities）配置正確，且收到的設備符合原始訂購規格。IQ 具有「儀器專屬性」（instrument-specific）——同型號的兩台儀器仍須各自完成 IQ，且若設備日後被搬動到實驗室內其他位置或另一使用場所，部分 IQ 項目可能需要重做（可攜式設計的儀器例外）。
blocks.en: Installation Qualification (IQ): Demonstrates that the equipment has been installed "correctly and safely", that utilities are configured correctly, and that the equipment received matches the original order specification. IQ is "instrument-specific": two instruments of the same model must each complete their own IQ, and if the equipment is later moved to another location in the laboratory or to another site of use, some IQ items may need to be repeated (instruments of portable design are the exception).

blocks.zh: 好比新家裝設中央空調：師傅安裝完成後，需要確認的不是「冷氣冷不冷」（那是後續的操作測試），而是「機型與訂單規格一致嗎？電源電壓對嗎？排水管接對了嗎？說明書、保固文件都在嗎？」。如果日後把室內機搬到另一個房間，這些安裝確認（電源、排水、配管）通常需要重新檢查一次，因為安裝環境改變了；但如果買的是一台可攜式移動空調，設計上本來就是要到處搬，就不需要每次搬動都重新走一遍安裝檢查流程。
blocks.en: It is like having central air conditioning installed in a new home: what needs to be confirmed once the installer has finished is not "whether the air conditioner cools" (that is the later operational test) but "does the model match the order specification? Is the supply voltage correct? Is the drain pipe connected properly? Are the manual and warranty documents all there?" If the indoor unit is later moved to another room, these installation checks (power, drainage, piping) usually need to be repeated because the installation environment has changed; but if what you bought is a portable air conditioner, which is designed to be moved around, the installation checks do not need to be repeated every time it is moved.

blocks.zh: 對於內含電腦化系統或微處理器控制的設備，IQ 文件必須記錄軟體版本號、作業系統版本、韌體設定等資訊——這份紀錄之後會成為變更管理（change control）的基準線（baseline）：日後若供應商釋出軟體更新，QA 可以立即比對「這次更新是否偏離了原始 IQ 建立的版本基準」，進而判斷是否需要重新確效（見 Section 5.2.3 CSV 與軟體更新管理的關聯）。
blocks.en: For equipment containing computerized systems or microprocessor control, the IQ documentation must record the software version number, operating system version, firmware settings and so on. This record later becomes the baseline for change control: if the supplier later releases a software update, QA can immediately compare whether "this update deviates from the version baseline established in the original IQ" and thus decide whether requalification is needed (see the link between CSV and software update management in Section 5.2.3).

blocks.zh: 某公司向供應商採購兩台相同型號的 AMM/RMM 儀器，分別安裝於 A、B 兩間實驗室。是否可以只對其中一台執行 IQ，另一台援引相同報告？為什麼？
blocks.en: A company buys two identical AMM/RMM instruments from a supplier and installs them in laboratories A and B. Can IQ be performed on only one of them, with the same report referenced for the other? Why?

blocks.zh: 若儀器的 IQ 由供應商執行並由終端使用者「見證」（witnessed），這與終端使用者「獨立執行」一份更完整的 IQ，兩者的差異與各自風險為何？
blocks.en: If the instrument IQ is performed by the supplier and "witnessed" by the end user, versus the end user performing a more complete IQ "independently", what are the differences and the respective risks?

blocks.zh: 5.2.5 Equipment Operational Qualification 設備操作確效
blocks.en: 5.2.5 Equipment Operational Qualification

blocks.zh: Operational Qualification (OQ，操作確效)：證明設備相關組件與功能（包括軟體）在依照操作程序運作時，能在「預先設定的限度內」正常運作。與 IQ 不同，OQ 關注的是「動態運作表現」而非「靜態安裝正確性」——例如加熱/冷卻速率、感測器與光學系統效能、使用者介面功能等。
blocks.en: Operational Qualification (OQ): Demonstrates that the relevant components and functions of the equipment (including software) operate "within predetermined limits" when run according to the operating procedure. Unlike IQ, OQ concerns "dynamic operating performance" rather than "static installation correctness", for example heating/cooling rates, sensor and optical system performance, and user interface functions.

blocks.zh: 電腦系統相關 OQ 項目：原文列出了一份相當完整的電腦系統測試清單，涵蓋管理員權限與操作員存取控制、使用者帳號密碼設定、使用者/系統鎖定機制、data integrity（資料完整性）、audit trails（稽核軌跡）、報告產出、系統整合、資料傳輸與伺服器通訊、資料備份與復原、資料庫管理與完整性，以及無線/射頻/電磁干擾測試。這份清單本質上就是把 21 CFR Part 11 對電子紀錄與電子簽章的要求，逐項轉譯成可執行的 OQ 測試項目。
blocks.en: Computer system-related OQ items: The source lists a fairly complete set of computer system tests, covering administrator privileges and operator access control, user account and password settings, user/system lockout mechanisms, data integrity, audit trails, report generation, system integration, data transfer and server communication, data backup and recovery, database management and integrity, and wireless/radio-frequency/electromagnetic interference testing. In essence this list translates the requirements of 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and electronic signatures item by item into executable OQ tests.

blocks.zh: 延續空調安裝的比喻：IQ 只確認「裝對了」，OQ 則是實際開機，測試冷氣是否能在設定溫度範圍內穩定製冷、風扇轉速是否符合各檔位規格、遙控器每個按鈕功能是否正確反應。若這台空調還具備「連網記錄用電量」的智慧功能，OQ 還必須測試帳號登入、資料是否正確回傳雲端、資料是否會被竄改——這就相當於原文中電子紀錄/電子簽章、稽核軌跡、資料備份等一長串電腦系統測試項目。
blocks.en: Continuing the air conditioner analogy: IQ confirms only that it was "installed correctly", while OQ actually switches it on and tests whether it can cool steadily within the set temperature range, whether the fan speed meets the specification at each setting, and whether every button on the remote control responds correctly. If the unit also has a smart function that "records power consumption over the network", OQ must also test account login, whether data are returned correctly to the cloud, and whether the data can be tampered with. This corresponds to the long list of computer system tests in the source: electronic records/electronic signatures, audit trails, data backup and so on.

blocks.zh: 凡是會產生電子紀錄或電子簽章的系統，21 CFR Part 11 要求其必須被「適當驗證」，確保紀錄「準確、可靠，且能依規定被維護與存取」。稽核軌跡（audit trail）的測試尤其關鍵——必須驗證系統能記錄「誰、何時、修改了什麼」，且該紀錄本身不可被使用者刪除或竄改。此外，原文也提醒需考慮無線電/電磁干擾測試，這在無塵室或多台儀器並存的實驗室環境中，是容易被忽略但實際會影響數據可靠性的風險來源。EU Annex 11 與 ISPE GAMP 提供了與 21 CFR Part 11 互補、但各有側重的電腦系統驗證框架，跨國營運的 CDMO 應同時參照兩者，以滿足不同法規機關的期待。
blocks.en: Any system that generates electronic records or electronic signatures must, under 21 CFR Part 11, be "appropriately validated" to ensure that records are "accurate, reliable, and can be maintained and accessed as required". Audit trail testing is especially critical: it must be verified that the system records "who changed what and when", and that this record itself cannot be deleted or altered by users. In addition, the source reminds readers to consider radio/electromagnetic interference testing, which is an easily overlooked but real source of risk to data reliability in cleanrooms or laboratory environments where several instruments coexist. EU Annex 11 and ISPE GAMP provide computer system validation frameworks that complement 21 CFR Part 11 but each with its own emphasis, and a multinational CDMO should refer to both to meet the expectations of different regulatory authorities.

blocks.zh: 若某 AMM/RMM 儀器的軟體僅供內部記錄用途、不會產生任何提交給法規機關的電子紀錄，是否仍需要進行完整的 21 CFR Part 11 相關 OQ 測試？
blocks.en: If the software of an AMM/RMM instrument is used only for internal recording and generates no electronic records to be submitted to regulatory authorities, is the full set of 21 CFR Part 11-related OQ tests still needed?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「使用者鎖定機制」與「稽核軌跡」被特別列為 OQ 階段必須測試的電腦系統項目？若這些功能測試失敗，可能造成什麼後果？
blocks.en: Why are "user lockout mechanisms" and "audit trails" specifically listed as computer system items that must be tested at the OQ stage? What consequences might there be if these function tests fail?

blocks.zh: 5.2.6 Equipment Performance Qualification 設備性能確效
blocks.en: 5.2.6 Equipment Performance Qualification

blocks.zh: Performance Qualification (PQ，性能確效)：證明設備在依操作程序安裝與運作時，能「持續」依預定標準產出正確結果——關鍵字是「consistently（持續）」，這與 OQ 的一次性功能驗證不同，PQ 更強調長期穩定性。原文指出 PQ 可透過 assay controls（分析對照組，如核酸標準品的外源/內源陽性對照、無模板對照、無擴增對照）來執行，而這些對照組在 PQ 目的下可被視為「實際產品測試的代表性樣本」。
blocks.en: Performance Qualification (PQ): Demonstrates that the equipment, installed and operated according to the operating procedure, "consistently" produces correct results to predetermined standards. The keyword is "consistently", which differs from the one-off functional verification of OQ; PQ places more emphasis on long-term stability. The source notes that PQ can be carried out using assay controls (such as exogenous/endogenous positive controls, no-template controls and no-amplification controls for nucleic acid standards), and for the purposes of PQ these controls can be regarded as "representative samples of actual product testing".

blocks.zh: PQ 與 Primary Validation 的橋接：本節是理解全篇最關鍵的轉折點——原文明確指出，供應商通常就是透過執行這類 PQ 型研究，來產生「初級驗證（Primary Validation）」數據，證明設備有能力偵測、計數、鑑別微生物。也就是說，5.2.6（設備確效的最後一步）與 5.3.1（方法驗證的第一步）在實務上經常是同一套實驗數據——差別在於審視的角度：PQ 問「這台設備能不能穩定產出正確結果」，Primary Validation 問「這個方法本身的分析性能是否達標」。
blocks.en: The bridge between PQ and Primary Validation: This is the most critical turning point for understanding the whole document. The source states explicitly that suppliers usually generate the "Primary Validation" data, showing that the equipment is capable of detecting, enumerating and identifying microorganisms, by performing studies of this PQ type. In other words, 5.2.6 (the last step of equipment qualification) and 5.3.1 (the first step of method validation) are in practice often the same set of experimental data. The difference is the angle of review: PQ asks "can this equipment consistently produce correct results?", whereas Primary Validation asks "does the analytical performance of the method itself meet the criteria?".

blocks.zh: 回到空調的例子：PQ 相當於「連續運轉三個月，每天記錄室溫是否穩定維持在設定範圍內」——不是裝完當天測一次就結束，而是要證明長期使用下依然可靠。而原文提到「用稀釋液中懸浮的微生物，而非真正的產品」進行初級驗證，就像測試這台空調時先用「空房間」測試溫控是否準確，還沒有把家具、寵物、日照等真實居住情境（產品基質）放進來測試——那些「真實情境下的相容性測試」，要留到後面的方法適用性（5.3.2）與比對測試（5.3.3）階段才進行。
blocks.en: Back to the air conditioner example: PQ is like "running continuously for three months and recording every day whether the room temperature stays steadily within the set range". It is not finished by measuring once on the day of installation but must show that the unit remains reliable over long-term use. The source's statement that primary validation uses "microorganisms suspended in diluent, rather than actual product" is like first testing the accuracy of the temperature control in an "empty room", without yet putting in real living conditions such as furniture, pets and sunlight (the product matrix). That "compatibility testing under real conditions" is left for the later Method Suitability (5.3.2) and Comparability Testing (5.3.3) stages.

blocks.zh: 原文清楚劃出一條界線：初級驗證使用的是「懸浮於適當稀釋液中的微生物」，不是實際的測試樣品或產品——真正的產品/樣品要等到方法適用性測試（Method Suitability, 5.3.2）與比對測試（Comparability Testing, 5.3.3）階段才會被引入。這個順序邏輯貫穿整個 5.3 節：先在「乾淨」的環境下證明方法本身有能力偵測目標微生物，再逐步加入產品基質，觀察是否產生訊號增強、遮蔽或干擾。若在初級驗證階段就混入產品基質，反而會讓「方法本身能力」與「產品基質干擾」兩個變因無法區分，使驗證邏輯失去意義。
blocks.en: The source draws a clear line: primary validation uses "microorganisms suspended in an appropriate diluent", not the actual test sample or product. The real product/sample is introduced only at the Method Suitability (5.3.2) and Comparability Testing (5.3.3) stages. This sequence logic runs through the whole of Section 5.3: first show in a "clean" environment that the method itself can detect the target microorganisms, then add the product matrix step by step and observe whether signal enhancement, masking or interference occurs. If the product matrix were mixed in at the primary validation stage, the two variables of "the capability of the method itself" and "interference from the product matrix" could not be separated, and the validation logic would lose its meaning.

blocks.zh: 某終端使用者打算把原本設計為「定量計數」的 AMM/RMM，改用於「存在/不存在」(presence/absence) 的定性判讀用途。根據原文，這是否屬於必須額外執行驗證的情境？為什麼？
blocks.en: An end user plans to change an AMM/RMM originally designed for "quantitative enumeration" to a qualitative presence/absence readout. According to the source, is this a situation requiring additional validation? Why?

blocks.zh: 為什麼供應商在 PQ 階段使用的「分析對照組」（如陽性對照、無模板對照）可以被視為「實際產品測試的代表性樣本」？這個邏輯的前提假設是什麼？
blocks.en: Why can the "assay controls" the supplier uses at the PQ stage (such as positive controls and no-template controls) be regarded as "representative samples of actual product testing"? What assumption underlies this logic?

blocks.zh: 5.3 Primary Validation, Method Suitability, and Comparability Testing 初級驗證、方法適用性與比對測試
blocks.en: 5.3 Primary Validation, Method Suitability, and Comparability Testing

blocks.zh: 驗證三部曲：Primary Validation（初級驗證，通常由供應商在無測試樣品情況下執行）→ Method Suitability（方法適用性，終端使用者在有測試樣品情況下執行，確認樣品基質不會干擾方法訊號）→ Comparability Testing（比對測試，終端使用者在有測試樣品情況下，將 AMM/RMM 與 Conventional Microbiological Method (CMM，傳統微生物方法) 並列比較）。三者由「供應商責任」逐步過渡到「終端使用者責任」，也由「無樣品」逐步過渡到「有樣品」。
blocks.en: The three stages of validation: Primary Validation (usually performed by the supplier without test samples) → Method Suitability (performed by the end user with test samples, confirming that the sample matrix does not interfere with the method signal) → Comparability Testing (performed by the end user with test samples, comparing the AMM/RMM side by side with the Conventional Microbiological Method (CMM)). Responsibility moves step by step from the "supplier" to the "end user", and the work moves from "without samples" to "with samples".

blocks.zh: 想像一間餐廳要導入一套新的自動炒菜機取代老師傅炒菜：初級驗證就像廠商在自己的測試廚房，用標準食材證明機器「炒得出這道菜」；方法適用性則是餐廳把「自己店裡實際使用的食材」（可能帶有特殊醬料、特定產地食材）放進機器測試，確認這些食材不會讓機器誤判火候或卡住；比對測試則是讓機器與老師傅同時用同一批食材各炒一盤，比較兩盤菜的味道是否相當——只有通過這三關，餐廳才能安心讓機器全面取代老師傅的位置。
blocks.en: Imagine a restaurant introducing an automatic stir-fry machine to replace a chef. Primary validation is like the manufacturer, in its own test kitchen, using standard ingredients to prove the machine "can cook this dish". Method suitability is the restaurant putting "the ingredients it actually uses" (which may carry special sauces or ingredients from particular origins) into the machine to confirm they do not make the machine misjudge the heat or jam. Comparability testing has the machine and the chef each cook a plate from the same batch of ingredients, and compares whether the flavor of the two plates is equivalent. Only after passing all three gates can the restaurant be comfortable letting the machine fully replace the chef.

blocks.zh: 原文的 Note 提出一個容易被忽略但影響深遠的規則：當已驗證的 AMM/RMM 要被「新一代方法」或「另一個 AMM/RMM」取代時，新方法必須與 CMM（傳統方法） 重新比對驗證，而不是與「目前已驗證的舊 AMM/RMM」比對。這避免了「新方法只需比舊方法好一點點」的漂移風險（validation drift）——如果每次新一代方法都只跟上一代比較，經過多次世代更迭後，最終方法的表現可能已經悄悄偏離了最初與藥典傳統方法建立的可比性基準，卻沒有人注意到。這對長期使用 AMM/RMM 的 CDMO 尤其重要：技術世代更新是常態，但比對的「錨點」永遠應該是 CMM，而非上一代 AMM/RMM。
blocks.en: The Note in the source states a rule that is easily overlooked but far-reaching: when a validated AMM/RMM is to be replaced by a "new-generation method" or "another AMM/RMM", the new method must be revalidated by comparison with the CMM (conventional method), not with "the currently validated old AMM/RMM". This avoids the risk of drift (validation drift) in which the "new method only has to be a little better than the old one". If every new generation were compared only with the previous one, after several generations the performance of the final method might have quietly departed from the comparability baseline originally established with the compendial conventional method without anyone noticing. This is especially important for CDMOs that use AMM/RMM over the long term: technology generations are renewed as a matter of course, but the comparison "anchor" should always be the CMM, not the previous-generation AMM/RMM.

blocks.zh: 若貴公司計畫將現行已驗證的 AMM/RMM 升級為同供應商的新一代機型，根據原文的 Note，驗證比對的對象應該是誰？
blocks.en: If your company plans to upgrade a currently validated AMM/RMM to a new-generation model from the same supplier, what should the validation comparison be made against, according to the Note in the source?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「與 CMM 比對」而非「與舊版 AMM/RMM 比對」能避免長期的驗證漂移風險？
blocks.en: Why does comparing "with the CMM" rather than "with the old AMM/RMM" avoid long-term validation drift?

blocks.zh: 5.3.1 Primary Validation 初級驗證
blocks.en: 5.3.1 Primary Validation

blocks.zh: Primary Validation（初級驗證）：通常由供應商在「無測試樣品」情況下執行，目的是證明系統/方法本身有能力偵測、計數或鑑別微生物，且工作流程能有效取得預期偵測目標（例如從活菌中萃取細胞標的、建立增菌步驟的最短培養時間、活性染劑吸收所需的活化條件）。也可使用替代標的（surrogate targets，如純化核酸、ATP、標準化螢光微珠）來證明技術能力，只要該標的適用於該技術。
blocks.en: Primary Validation: Usually performed by the supplier "without test samples", with the aim of demonstrating that the system/method itself is capable of detecting, enumerating or identifying microorganisms and that the workflow effectively obtains the expected detection target (for example extracting the cellular target from viable organisms, establishing the minimum incubation time for an enrichment step, or the activation conditions needed for uptake of a viability dye). Surrogate targets (such as purified nucleic acid, ATP or standardized fluorescent microbeads) may also be used to demonstrate technical capability, as long as the target is appropriate for the technology.

blocks.zh:
定性 vs 定量方法的驗證指標矩陣：這是本節最重要的技術重點——
定性方法（qualitative）：specificity（特異性）、LoD（偵測極限）、ruggedness（穩健度/中間精密度）、robustness（耐用性）。
定量方法（quantitative）：specificity、accuracy（準確度）、repeatability（重複性）、LoQ（定量極限）、range（範圍）、linearity（線性）、ruggedness、robustness——比定性方法多了 accuracy、repeatability、LoQ、range、linearity 五項。這個差異反映了兩類方法的本質：定性方法只需回答「有沒有」，定量方法必須回答「有多少，而且測得準不準、穩不穩」。
blocks.en:
Matrix of validation parameters for qualitative vs. quantitative methods: This is the most important technical point of this section.
Qualitative methods: specificity, LoD (limit of detection), ruggedness (intermediate precision), robustness.
Quantitative methods: specificity, accuracy, repeatability, LoQ (limit of quantitation), range, linearity, ruggedness, robustness. This is five more than for qualitative methods: accuracy, repeatability, LoQ, range and linearity. This difference reflects the nature of the two kinds of method: a qualitative method only has to answer "is it there or not", whereas a quantitative method must answer "how much, and is the measurement accurate and stable".

blocks.zh: 延續前段餐廳自動炒菜機的比喻：定性驗證就像測試機器「能不能正確判斷這道菜有沒有放辣椒」（有/沒有二選一）；定量驗證則像測試機器「能不能量出這道菜到底放了幾克辣椒，而且每次量測結果都要一致、在合理範圍內線性反應辣度」。後者需要驗證的項目自然比前者多更多，因為「量出正確數字」比「判斷有沒有」複雜得多。
blocks.en: Continuing the restaurant stir-fry machine analogy: qualitative validation is like testing whether the machine "can correctly judge whether a dish contains chili" (a yes/no choice), while quantitative validation is like testing whether the machine "can measure how many grams of chili the dish contains, with consistent results each time and a linear response to the level of spiciness within a reasonable range". The latter naturally requires many more items to be validated than the former, because "measuring the right number" is far more complicated than "judging whether it is there".

blocks.zh: 原文列出的四個「終端使用者必須自行重做初級驗證」的觸發情境，是這一節對 CDMO 實務最直接的風險判斷工具：（1）使用方式與供應商定義不同、（2）終端使用者更動了設備參數、（3）供應商測試的菌種組合不能代表終端使用者實際需求、（4）供應商根本沒做過初級驗證。任何一項成立，終端使用者就不能單純援引供應商數據，必須自行以相關微生物、在無產品/樣品情況下重新執行初級驗證——可考慮使用替代標的物（surrogate analytes）作為簡化手段，但前提是方法仍能持續從活菌中擷取目標。這四項觸發條件應該被納入 CDMO 內部「AMM/RMM 導入風險評估表」的標準檢核項目。
blocks.en: The four situations listed in the source in which the "end user must repeat the primary validation" are the most direct risk-judgment tool of this section for CDMO practice: (1) the method is used differently from the way the supplier defined, (2) the end user has altered equipment parameters, (3) the organism panel tested by the supplier does not represent the end user's actual needs, (4) the supplier never performed a primary validation. If any one of these applies, the end user cannot simply reference the supplier's data and must repeat the primary validation itself with relevant microorganisms and without product/sample. Surrogate analytes may be considered as a simplification, provided the method can still consistently extract the target from viable organisms. These four triggering conditions should be built into the standard checklist of the CDMO's internal "AMM/RMM implementation risk assessment form".

blocks.zh: 某 CDMO 採購一台快速微生物偵測儀，供應商提供的初級驗證數據涵蓋了標準藥典指標菌株（如 E. coli、S. aureus），但該 CDMO 生產的細胞治療產品環境監測歷史顯示，廠區常見分離株包含特定的環境黴菌菌種，並未涵蓋在供應商的驗證菌種清單中。根據原文第三項觸發情境（供應商菌種組合不具代表性），該 CDMO 應規劃自行執行針對性的初級驗證，納入這些廠區特有的分離株，而不能直接援引供應商的原始數據作為完整驗證依據。
blocks.en: A CDMO buys a rapid microbial detection instrument. The primary validation data from the supplier cover the standard compendial indicator strains (such as E. coli and S. aureus), but the environmental monitoring history of the CDMO's cell therapy product shows that common isolates in the facility include specific environmental mold species that are not in the supplier's list of validated organisms. Under the third trigger in the source (the supplier's organism panel is not representative), the CDMO should plan to perform its own targeted primary validation that includes these facility-specific isolates, and cannot directly reference the supplier's original data as the complete basis for validation.

blocks.zh: 某快速微生物方法同時具備定量計數與定性存在/不存在兩種應用模式，供應商應如何規劃初級驗證的範疇？
blocks.en: A rapid microbial method has both a quantitative enumeration mode and a qualitative presence/absence application mode. How should the supplier plan the scope of the primary validation?

blocks.zh: 如果終端使用者只是把儀器的預設培養溫度從供應商建議的 30-35°C 調整為 20-25°C（因應黴菌培養需求），這算不算「equipment parameters are altered」而需要重做初級驗證？
blocks.en: If the end user merely adjusts the instrument's default incubation temperature from the supplier-recommended 30-35°C to 20-25°C (to accommodate mold culture), does this count as "equipment parameters are altered" requiring the primary validation to be repeated?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「使用替代標的物」（如純化核酸、ATP）可以作為簡化初級驗證的手段，但前提是「方法仍能從活菌中擷取目標」？
blocks.en: Why can the "use of surrogate analytes" (such as purified nucleic acid or ATP) serve as a simplification of primary validation, on the condition that "the method can still extract the target from viable organisms"?

blocks.zh: 5.3.2 Method Suitability 方法適用性
blocks.en: 5.3.2 Method Suitability

blocks.zh: Method Suitability（方法適用性）：是「產品/樣品專屬」的驗證，必須在測試樣品存在的情況下、依預定的樣品前處理步驟與工作流程執行。每一個新的測試樣品或產品配方原則上都應評估適用性，除非能透過風險評估提出正當理由（例如已在類似樣品基質上做過研究，或該配方僅是某成分如 API 濃度較高的變化版本）。
blocks.en: Method Suitability: A "product/sample-specific" validation that must be performed with the test sample present, following the predefined sample preparation steps and workflow. Suitability should in principle be evaluated for every new test sample or product formulation, unless a justification can be made through risk assessment (for example, studies have already been performed on a similar sample matrix, or the formulation is merely a variant with a higher concentration of one component such as the API).

blocks.zh: 批次數量與統計依據：原文給出明確的數字基準——通常評估三 (3) 個獨立批次即被視為合適的做法（若可取得），除非有風險評估與產品知識支持的其他理由。批次間差異（原料、製程條件、產品放置時間）都可能影響微生物回收率、訊號干擾或基質效應。
blocks.en: Number of batches and statistical basis: The source gives a clear numerical benchmark: evaluating three (3) independent batches is generally regarded as appropriate practice (if available), unless there is another justification supported by risk assessment and product knowledge. Batch-to-batch differences (raw materials, process conditions, product hold time) can all affect microbial recovery, signal interference or matrix effects.

blocks.zh: False-positive vs False-negative 測試設計：False-positive testing 是「有樣品、無挑戰菌」的情境，用來確認樣品本身不會產生假訊號或背景噪音；False-negative testing 則是「在實際使用條件下、用相關菌種組合挑戰」，確認樣品基質不會遮蔽、抑制或干擾對活菌的偵測。定性方法必須在挑戰菌存在下呈現陽性反應；定量方法則必須相較於對照組（如適當稀釋液）回收至少 50% 的接種挑戰菌——這是一個具體、可稽核的數字門檻。
blocks.en: False-positive vs. false-negative test design: False-positive testing is the scenario "with sample, without challenge organisms", used to confirm that the sample itself does not generate false signals or background noise. False-negative testing is "challenging with a relevant panel of organisms under actual conditions of use", confirming that the sample matrix does not mask, inhibit or interfere with the detection of viable organisms. A qualitative method must give a positive response in the presence of the challenge organisms; a quantitative method must recover at least 50% of the inoculated challenge organisms compared with the control (such as the appropriate diluent). This is a concrete, auditable numerical threshold.

blocks.zh: 回到自動炒菜機的比喻：方法適用性測試就是把「這家餐廳實際會用的食材」（帶有特定醬料、油脂、辛香料）放進機器，測試兩件事——第一，光是這批食材本身，機器會不會誤判成「有加辣椒」（false positive，即使廚房根本沒加辣椒粉，某種醬料顏色或氣味卻讓感測器誤判）；第二，如果真的加入標準劑量的辣椒粉，機器在這批食材的干擾下，是否仍能偵測到至少一半的辣度訊號（false negative 測試，量化方法要求至少回收 50%）。而「評估三個獨立批次」就像不只測試一批進貨的食材，而是分別測試三批不同產地、不同時間進貨的同款食材，確認結果不會因為食材批次波動而失準。
blocks.en: Back to the stir-fry machine analogy: the method suitability test puts "the ingredients this restaurant will actually use" (with particular sauces, oils and spices) into the machine and tests two things. First, whether the machine, given this batch of ingredients alone, mistakenly judges it as "chili added" (false positive: even though no chili powder was added to the kitchen, the color or smell of a certain sauce causes the sensor to misjudge). Second, if a standard dose of chili powder is indeed added, whether the machine can still detect at least half of the spiciness signal despite interference from this batch of ingredients (false-negative test; quantitative methods require recovery of at least 50%). "Evaluating three independent batches" is like testing not just one delivery of ingredients but three deliveries of the same ingredient from different origins and different times, to confirm that the result does not go off because of batch-to-batch variation in the ingredients.

blocks.zh: 原文提出一個實務上非常有價值的「效率捷徑」：如果樣品基質已經在「預期用途測試」或「比對測試」中被評估過，且挑戰菌濃度落在方法適用性測試常用的數值範圍內（例如低於 100 CFU，但不一定要落在方法宣稱的 LoD 或 LoQ），則可以不必另外執行獨立的方法適用性研究——這代表 TR 33 鼓勵合理的實驗設計整合，避免重複測試消耗寶貴的產品樣品。另一個關鍵重點是「方法轉移」（method transfer）：當方法轉移到不同廠址時，仍需執行方法適用性測試以證明該廠址能正確操作方法，且若當地廠區特有的分離株對產品、製程或病人構成風險、又未被原始驗證場址評估過，可能需要額外研究——這與 Section 6.4（方法轉移）直接相關，CDMO 跨廠區複製驗證方法時必須特別留意。
blocks.en: The source offers a very valuable practical "efficiency shortcut": if the sample matrix has already been evaluated in "intended-use testing" or "comparability testing", and the challenge organism level falls within the range commonly used for method suitability testing (for example below 100 CFU, but not necessarily at the method's claimed LoD or LoQ), a separate method suitability study need not be performed. This shows that TR 33 encourages sensible integration of experimental design to avoid repeat testing that consumes valuable product samples. Another key point is "method transfer": when a method is transferred to a different site, method suitability testing must still be performed to show that the site can operate the method correctly, and if isolates specific to the local site pose a risk to the product, process or patient and were not evaluated at the original validation site, additional studies may be needed. This is directly related to Section 6.4 (method transfer), and a CDMO replicating a validated method across sites must pay particular attention to it.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
定量方法之方法適用性接受標準（原文明定）：

回收率 = (AMM/RMM 於樣品中回收之挑戰菌數 / 對照組[稀釋液]中回收之挑戰菌數) × 100%

接受標準：回收率 ≥ 50%

批次評估數量基準：
獨立批次數 = 3（若可取得），
              除非風險評估與產品知識可佐證合理的減量或加量
blocks.en:
Acceptance criterion for method suitability of quantitative methods (as stated in the source):

Recovery = (number of challenge organisms recovered by the AMM/RMM in the sample / number of challenge organisms recovered in the control [diluent]) × 100%

Acceptance criterion: recovery ≥ 50%

Benchmark for number of batches evaluated:
Number of independent batches = 3 (if available),
              unless risk assessment and product knowledge support a justified reduction or increase

blocks.zh: 某 CDMO 有一項新產品配方，僅是既有已驗證配方中 API 濃度提高兩倍。根據原文，是否可以豁免重新執行方法適用性測試？需要什麼樣的支持文件？
blocks.en: A CDMO has a new product formulation that is simply an existing validated formulation with the API concentration doubled. According to the source, can it be exempted from repeating the method suitability test? What supporting documentation is required?

blocks.zh: 為什麼定量方法的方法適用性接受標準是「至少回收 50%」，而非要求 100% 完全回收？這個門檻背後隱含了什麼樣的風險容忍邏輯？
blocks.en: Why is the method suitability acceptance criterion for quantitative methods "recovery of at least 50%" rather than requiring 100% recovery? What risk-tolerance logic is implied behind this threshold?

blocks.zh: 對於無法被終端使用者直接以挑戰菌接種的 AMM/RMM（例如空氣監測用生物螢光微粒計數器），原文建議如何執行方法適用性測試？
blocks.en: For an AMM/RMM that the end user cannot directly inoculate with challenge organisms (for example a bio-fluorescent particle counter for air monitoring), how does the source recommend performing the method suitability test?

blocks.zh: 5.3.3 Comparability Testing in the Presence of the Test Sample 樣品存在下之比對測試
blocks.en: 5.3.3 Comparability Testing in the Presence of the Test Sample

blocks.zh: Comparability Testing（比對測試）：通常由終端使用者在測試樣品存在下，同時使用 AMM/RMM 與 CMM 執行，目的是證明 AMM/RMM 的偵測（定性）或計數（定量）結果與 CMM「相當」——注意原文精確的用字：不是「統計上無差異」也不是「優於」，而是依所採用的統計方法而定，可能是 equivalence（等效性）、non-inferiority（非劣性）或 superiority（優越性）三種假設檢定框架之一。
blocks.en: Comparability Testing: Usually performed by the end user in the presence of the test sample, using the AMM/RMM and the CMM side by side, with the aim of demonstrating that the AMM/RMM detection (qualitative) or enumeration (quantitative) results are "comparable" to those of the CMM. Note the precise wording of the source: it is neither "statistically no different" nor "better", but, depending on the statistical method adopted, may be one of three hypothesis testing frameworks: equivalence, non-inferiority or superiority.

blocks.zh: 菌種選擇的科學依據：比對測試所用菌種應有明確科學理由，可能來自 CMM 歷史上實際回收菌種的頻率與類型、藥典法要求的指標菌株、環境/廠區分離株，或對產品/製程/病人具風險的菌種。若廠區分離株與藥典指標菌株相似，可提出正當理由不予評估。
blocks.en: Scientific basis for organism selection: The organisms used in comparability testing should have a clear scientific rationale. They may come from the frequency and types of organisms historically recovered by the CMM, the indicator strains required by compendial methods, environmental/facility isolates, or organisms that pose a risk to the product, process or patient. If facility isolates are similar to compendial indicator strains, a justification may be given for not evaluating them.

blocks.zh: 挑戰濃度設計：實際挑戰濃度由終端使用者決定，測試方法宣稱的 LoD 或 LoQ 時，挑戰濃度可能只需 1-5 個微生物細胞，或評估一系列分數範圍（fractional range）的稀釋液——這是低濃度挑戰測試設計上常見的操作方式。
blocks.en: Design of challenge levels: The actual challenge level is determined by the end user. When testing the claimed LoD or LoQ of the method, the challenge level may need only 1-5 microbial cells, or a series of diluents covering a fractional range may be evaluated. This is a common way of designing low-level challenge tests.

blocks.zh: 比對測試就是讓自動炒菜機與老師傅，用同一批實際店內食材、同一批調味料，各自炒出一盤菜，然後用「盲測評審」（統計檢定）比較兩盤菜的鹹淡是否相當——評審不是要證明機器炒得比師傅「更好吃」，而是要證明兩者「差不到哪去」（相當、非劣或優越，視預先設定的檢定框架而定）。若店裡食材有限、不能反覆重炒測試，主廚（終端使用者）可以合理縮減測試範圍，只在「最難炒的臨界火候」（偵測極限）比較一次，而不必每個火候都比對一輪——前提是這個縮減範圍的理由要站得住腳。
blocks.en: Comparability testing has the automatic stir-fry machine and the chef each cook a plate using the same batch of actual in-restaurant ingredients and the same seasonings, and then uses "blind-tasting judges" (statistical testing) to compare whether the saltiness of the two plates is comparable. The judges are not trying to prove that the machine cooks "tastier" than the chef, but that the two are "not far apart" (comparable, non-inferior or superior, depending on the testing framework set in advance). If ingredients in the restaurant are limited and tests cannot be repeated, the head chef (the end user) can reasonably reduce the testing scope and compare only once at the "most difficult borderline heat" (the limit of detection), without comparing at every heat level, provided that the rationale for the reduced scope is sound.

blocks.zh: 本節提供了三個重要的「效率整合」原則，值得 CDMO 在設計驗證計畫時特別留意：（1）若方法適用性測試已用相關菌種組合測試過，比對測試可合理選用「部分」相同挑戰菌，不必全部重新評估；（2）供應商在初級驗證階段（無產品情況下）所做的穩健度（ruggedness）研究結果，視產品/樣品類型與製程而定，可能可以直接援引，不必在比對測試階段重複；（3）當某測試樣品已成功通過比對測試接受標準後，配方或基質相似的「新樣品」不必重複比對測試——但成分本質上不同的新樣品（原文舉例：細胞治療產品 vs 寡肽類產品）仍可能需要重新執行。這三項原則的共同精神，是把驗證資源集中在真正具有科學不確定性的地方，而非機械式地對每個新樣品重複整套測試。
blocks.en: This section offers three important "efficiency integration" principles that a CDMO should pay particular attention to when designing the validation plan: (1) if method suitability testing has already been done with a relevant panel of organisms, comparability testing may reasonably use "some" of the same challenge organisms and need not re-evaluate all of them; (2) the results of the ruggedness study done by the supplier at the primary validation stage (without product), depending on the product/sample type and process, may be directly referenced and need not be repeated at the comparability testing stage; (3) once a test sample has successfully passed the comparability testing acceptance criteria, a "new sample" with a similar formulation or matrix need not repeat comparability testing, but a new sample that is fundamentally different in composition (the source gives the example of a cell therapy product vs. an oligopeptide product) may still require it to be performed again. The common spirit of these three principles is to concentrate validation resources where there is real scientific uncertainty, rather than mechanically repeating the whole set of tests for every new sample.

blocks.zh:
低濃度挑戰測試設計範例（於 LoD/LoQ 附近）：

挑戰濃度 = 1-5 個微生物細胞
          或
          一系列分數稀釋（fractional dilution series）

比對測試驗證指標對照表：
  定性方法（qualitative）  → specificity, LoD
  定量方法（quantitative） → specificity, accuracy,
                              repeatability, LoQ
  （定性/定量皆可）        → ruggedness（可援引供應商
                              初級驗證數據，視情況而定）
blocks.en:
Example of a low-level challenge test design (near the LoD/LoQ):

Challenge level = 1-5 microbial cells
          or
          a series of fractional dilutions (fractional dilution series)

Comparison of validation parameters for comparability testing:
  Qualitative methods  → specificity, LoD
  Quantitative methods → specificity, accuracy,
                              repeatability, LoQ
  (qualitative or quantitative) → ruggedness (supplier primary validation
                              data may be referenced, as appropriate)

blocks.zh: 某 CDMO 承接一項細胞治療產品的微生物快篩導入案，先前已針對某一款寡肽類產品完成該 AMM/RMM 的完整比對測試並通過接受標準。若直接將該比對測試結果套用到細胞治療產品，是不恰當的——根據原文明確舉例的差異情境（human cell-based therapy vs oligopeptide-based product），兩者組成本質上截然不同，細胞治療產品可能含有更複雜的基質成分、蛋白質濃度與細胞碎片，可能對 AMM/RMM 訊號產生原本寡肽產品不會出現的干擾或遮蔽效應，因此必須針對細胞治療產品重新執行完整的比對測試，而非援引既有寡肽產品的驗證結論。
blocks.en: A CDMO has taken on a project to introduce a rapid microbial screening method for a cell therapy product, and has previously completed full comparability testing of that AMM/RMM for an oligopeptide product and passed the acceptance criteria. Applying those comparability testing results directly to the cell therapy product would be inappropriate. According to the source's explicit example of differing scenarios (human cell-based therapy vs. oligopeptide-based product), the two are fundamentally different in composition. A cell therapy product may contain more complex matrix components, protein concentrations and cell debris, which may interfere with or mask the AMM/RMM signal in ways an oligopeptide product would not, so full comparability testing must be repeated for the cell therapy product rather than relying on the validation conclusions for the existing oligopeptide product.

blocks.zh: 當測試樣品供應有限（例如珍貴的細胞治療批次），原文允許何種「縮減測試」的替代策略？這個策略的適用前提是什麼？
blocks.en: When the supply of test sample is limited (for example, a precious cell therapy batch), what alternative "reduced testing" strategy does the source allow? What is the precondition for applying it?

blocks.zh: 若某廠區分離株的出現頻率與藥典指標菌株非常相似，是否可以此為由，不將該廠區分離株納入比對測試的挑戰菌種組合？需要什麼樣的佐證？
blocks.en: If the frequency of occurrence of a facility isolate is very similar to that of a compendial indicator strain, can this be given as the reason for not including the facility isolate in the comparability testing organism panel? What supporting evidence is required?

blocks.zh: 供應商在初級驗證階段（無產品情況下）執行的穩健度研究，在什麼情況下可以直接援引用於比對測試階段，而不需要終端使用者重新執行？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances can the ruggedness study the supplier performed at the primary validation stage (without product) be directly referenced for the comparability testing stage without the end user repeating it?

blocks.zh: 5.3.4 Unique Methods Requiring Additional or Modified Validation Strategies 需要額外或修改驗證策略之特殊方法
blocks.en: 5.3.4 Unique Methods Requiring Additional or Modified Validation Strategies

blocks.zh: 特殊驗證策略的適用情境：TR 33 全篇討論的驗證策略，預設分析對象是「液態懸浮液中標準化培養的微生物」。但當偵測系統物理上無法引入液態懸浮液進行分析時（例如空氣監測、氣膠或其他非液態樣品的技術），標準驗證策略就不完全適用，需要擴充或調整——前提是調整後的測試方法仍具備科學正當性。
blocks.en: When special validation strategies apply: The validation strategy discussed throughout TR 33 assumes by default that the object of analysis is "standardized cultured microorganisms in a liquid suspension". When the detection system physically cannot take in a liquid suspension for analysis (for example air monitoring, aerosols or other non-liquid sample technologies), the standard validation strategy does not fully apply and needs to be extended or adjusted, provided that the adjusted test method remains scientifically justified.

blocks.zh: 好比一般的水質檢測儀是把水樣直接倒進機器測量，但空氣品質監測儀無法把「一杯空氣」倒進去化驗——它必須用完全不同的採樣與偵測原理（例如持續抽氣、雷射粒子計數、生物螢光偵測）。因此空氣監測設備的驗證邏輯，不能照搬水質檢測儀「倒入標準液體樣品」的驗證方式，必須重新設計符合其物理特性的驗證策略。
blocks.en: An ordinary water quality analyzer works by pouring the water sample straight into the machine, but an air quality monitor cannot have "a cup of air" poured in for testing. It needs a completely different sampling and detection principle (for example continuous air intake, laser particle counting, bio-fluorescence detection). Therefore the validation logic for air monitoring equipment cannot copy the "pour in a standard liquid sample" approach used for water analyzers and must be redesigned into a validation strategy that fits its physical characteristics.

blocks.zh: 本節與 5.3.2 提到的「空氣監測用生物螢光微粒計數器」呼應——這類終端使用者難以直接以挑戰菌接種的技術，往往需要供應商在驗證過程中扮演更吃重的角色，因為終端使用者通常不具備開發此類特殊驗證方法所需的專業知識或特殊設備。對 CDMO 而言，導入這類非傳統偵測技術（如即時空氣微生物監測）時，應在採購階段的 URS 與供應商評估中，明確要求供應商提供充分的驗證支援承諾與技術文件，而非假設可以套用標準的液態懸浮液驗證流程。
blocks.en: This section echoes the "bio-fluorescent particle counter for air monitoring" mentioned in 5.3.2. For this type of technology, which end users find hard to inoculate directly with challenge organisms, the supplier often needs to play a heavier role in the validation process, because end users usually lack the expertise or special equipment needed to develop such special validation methods. When a CDMO introduces such non-traditional detection technologies (such as real-time airborne microbial monitoring), it should explicitly require, in the URS and supplier evaluation at the procurement stage, that the supplier provide adequate commitments on validation support and technical documentation, rather than assuming the standard liquid suspension validation workflow can be applied.

blocks.zh: 為什麼氣膠或空氣監測類的 AMM/RMM 技術，無法直接套用 TR 33 針對液態懸浮液微生物所設計的標準驗證策略？
blocks.en: Why can aerosol or air monitoring AMM/RMM technologies not directly apply the standard validation strategy TR 33 designed for microorganisms in liquid suspension?

blocks.zh: 對於這類特殊技術，終端使用者在供應商評估與 URS 階段，應該特別要求供應商提供哪些支援？
blocks.en: For this type of special technology, what support should the end user specifically require the supplier to provide at the supplier evaluation and URS stage?

blocks.zh: 5.4 Recommendations for Conducting Validation Studies 執行驗證研究之建議（導論）
blocks.en: 5.4 Recommendations for Conducting Validation Studies (Introduction)

blocks.zh: Section 5.4 的定位：從本節起（5.4.1 至 5.4.11，將於後續章節逐一展開），TR 33 針對每一項驗證指標（specificity、accuracy、repeatability、LoD、LoQ、range、linearity、ruggedness、robustness 等）分別提供測試程序、接受標準與統計分析方法的具體建議。原文特別提醒一項效率原則：不同驗證指標的研究設計可以「共用數據」——例如線性測試取得的數據，也可以同時用於準確度測試的分析，避免重複消耗珍貴的微生物與樣品資源。
blocks.en: Position of Section 5.4: From this section onward (5.4.1 to 5.4.11, developed one by one in the following sections), TR 33 gives specific recommendations on test procedures, acceptance criteria and statistical analysis methods for each validation parameter (specificity, accuracy, repeatability, LoD, LoQ, range, linearity, ruggedness, robustness and so on). The source specifically points out an efficiency principle: the study designs for different validation parameters can "share data". For example, data obtained from linearity testing can also be used for the accuracy analysis, avoiding repeated consumption of precious microorganisms and samples.

blocks.zh: 好比做一次體檢抽血，一管血樣可以同時送檢驗肝功能、血脂、血糖多項指標，不需要為每一項檢查都重新抽一次血。同理，設計驗證實驗時，若在不同稀釋濃度下測試線性關係，這批數據本身也能拿來分析準確度——聰明的實驗設計可以讓一次性投入（微生物、樣品、人力）產出多重驗證證據。
blocks.en: It is like drawing blood for a health check-up: one tube of blood can be sent for several tests, such as liver function, blood lipids and blood glucose, without drawing blood again for each test. Likewise, when designing validation experiments, if the linear relationship is tested at different dilution levels, the same set of data can also be used to analyze accuracy. Smart experimental design lets a single investment (microorganisms, samples, manpower) yield multiple pieces of validation evidence.

blocks.zh: 原文的 Note 傳達了 TR 33 一貫的彈性精神：後續 5.4.1-5.4.11 提出的建議「並非窮盡所有可能」，供應商與利益關係人可以基於風險評估提出替代策略（修改、增加或減少測試），只要能被法規機關接受即可。TR 33 明確鼓勵利益關係人在啟動驗證計畫前，主動與相關法規機關討論所提出的驗證策略——這呼應了 Section 5.0 導論中「及早與法規機關溝通」的建議，也再次提醒讀者：本技術報告提供的是「科學合理的參考框架」，而非僵化不可變動的強制規範清單。
blocks.en: The Note in the source conveys the consistent flexibility of TR 33: the recommendations in 5.4.1-5.4.11 are "not exhaustive", and suppliers and stakeholders may propose alternative strategies (modified, additional or fewer tests) based on risk assessment, as long as they are acceptable to regulatory authorities. TR 33 explicitly encourages stakeholders to proactively discuss the proposed validation strategy with the relevant regulatory authorities before launching the validation program. This echoes the recommendation in the Section 5.0 introduction to "communicate early with regulatory authorities", and again reminds readers that this technical report provides a "scientifically sound reference framework" rather than a rigid, unchangeable list of mandatory rules.

blocks.zh: 舉一個原文以外、你認為可以「一次實驗、多重指標共用數據」的驗證設計範例（例如結合哪兩項驗證指標的測試）？
blocks.en: Give an example, other than those in the source, of a validation design in which "one experiment shares data across several parameters" (for example, which two validation parameters would be tested together)?

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 打算採用與 TR 33 建議不同的驗證策略（例如減少測試批次數）時，原文建議的正確做法是什麼？
blocks.en: When a CDMO intends to adopt a validation strategy different from the TR 33 recommendations (for example, reducing the number of test batches), what correct approach does the source recommend?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: AMM/RMM 系統的確效必須先完成設備確效（IQ → OQ → PQ，可視情況並行 IQ/OQ，但 PQ 須待 OQ 驗收核准後才能啟動）與電腦系統驗證（CSV，涵蓋 21 CFR Part 11、EU Annex 11、GAMP 要求），才能進入方法驗證階段
blocks.en: Qualification of an AMM/RMM system must first complete equipment qualification (IQ → OQ → PQ; IQ/OQ may run in parallel as appropriate, but PQ can start only after the OQ acceptance results are approved) and computer system validation (CSV, covering 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11 and GAMP requirements) before moving on to method validation

blocks.zh: PQ 與 Primary Validation 經常共用同一套實驗數據——PQ 問「設備能否持續產出正確結果」，Primary Validation 問「方法本身的分析性能是否達標」，兩者皆在「無產品/樣品」情況下以懸浮液中微生物執行
blocks.en: PQ and Primary Validation often share the same set of experimental data. PQ asks "can the equipment consistently produce correct results", Primary Validation asks "does the analytical performance of the method itself meet the criteria", and both are performed without product/sample using microorganisms in suspension

blocks.zh: 驗證三部曲由供應商責任逐步過渡至終端使用者責任、由無樣品逐步過渡至有樣品：Primary Validation（供應商，無樣品）→ Method Suitability（終端使用者，有樣品，確認基質不干擾訊號，定量方法須回收 ≥50% 挑戰菌）→ Comparability Testing（終端使用者，有樣品，與 CMM 比較，須具科學正當性選定菌種與濃度）
blocks.en: The three stages of validation move from supplier responsibility to end-user responsibility and from without sample to with sample: Primary Validation (supplier, no sample) → Method Suitability (end user, with sample, confirming the matrix does not interfere with the signal; quantitative methods must recover ≥50% of challenge organisms) → Comparability Testing (end user, with sample, compared with the CMM; organisms and levels must be scientifically justified)

blocks.zh: 定性方法驗證指標為 specificity、LoD、ruggedness、robustness；定量方法額外需要 accuracy、repeatability、LoQ、range、linearity；當已驗證的 AMM/RMM 被新一代方法取代時，新方法必須與 CMM（而非舊 AMM/RMM）重新比對驗證，以避免驗證漂移
blocks.en: The validation parameters for qualitative methods are specificity, LoD, ruggedness and robustness; quantitative methods additionally need accuracy, repeatability, LoQ, range and linearity. When a validated AMM/RMM is replaced by a new-generation method, the new method must be revalidated by comparison with the CMM (not the old AMM/RMM) to avoid validation drift

blocks.zh: 特殊非液態樣品技術（如空氣/氣膠監測）需要調整或擴充標準驗證策略，且供應商須扮演更吃重的支援角色；後續 5.4.1-5.4.11 將針對各驗證指標提供具體測試程序與統計分析建議，允許基於風險評估的替代策略，並鼓勵及早與法規機關溝通
blocks.en: Special non-liquid sample technologies (such as air/aerosol monitoring) require the standard validation strategy to be adjusted or extended, and the supplier must play a heavier support role. Sections 5.4.1-5.4.11 that follow will give specific test procedures and statistical analysis recommendations for each validation parameter, allow alternative strategies based on risk assessment, and encourage early communication with regulatory authorities
